summary: IceCure Medical Ltd. (Israeli medical-device company) filed a Form 6-K disclosing an at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners. The company may offer and sell ordinary shares (no par value) from time to time via an existing F-3 shelf. No specific price, share count, or premium is stated; commissions are 3% of gross proceeds. Proceeds will fund working capital. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. What to watch: sales execution and dilution for existing holders.
